subject.title: Support Workers AI model selection during onboard

question: Should non-interactive Workers AI onboarding generate a dedicated Workers AI provider mode, or should it use the broader Cloudflare REST multi-provider gateway contract tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94554?
rationale: This determines the stable CLI/config surface, provider identity, endpoint and auth semantics, model-ID mapping, defaults, and compatibility plan; source inspection cannot infer the intended product contract.

options.title: Use shared REST gateway contract
options.body: Define the broader Cloudflare REST/multi-provider contract first and make this onboarding requirement an explicit acceptance criterion of that design.

options.title: Add dedicated Workers AI mode
options.body: Add a separate plugin-owned Workers AI endpoint/model mode while preserving the existing Anthropic path and documenting their distinct contracts.

recommendation.title: Use shared REST gateway contract
recommendation.body: Define the broader Cloudflare REST/multi-provider contract first and make this onboarding requirement an explicit acceptance criterion of that design.

likelyOwner.reason: They landed the original feature and carried the largest subsequent refactors across the exact onboarding, model, and plugin surfaces.
